parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — I’m sorry for the trouble. I understand you were charged twice for your annual plan renewal on May 1, and the two invoice numbers involved are INV-9031 and INV-9032. 

We’ve escalated this to our billing team to review the charges and determine which one can be reversed while keeping the correct invoice for your accounting.

To make sure we match the payments accurately, could you please share:
1) The amounts for INV-9031 and INV-9032 (as shown on your invoice or billing email)
2) The last 4 digits of the card that was charged (or the payment method identifier)
3) Whether your bank/card statement shows both charges as fully posted/settled, or if one is pending

Once we have that, we’ll follow up with confirmation of which invoice should remain on your side.
promised_actions: Escalate the duplicate charge review to the billing team
Follow up with confirmation of which invoice should remain for your accounting after reviewing the provided details
safety_notes: Human review is required; response does not confirm which invoice will be reversed until billing team verifies the charges.
No refund promise or resolution guarantee is made; only escalation and follow-up are committed.
